startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Finn job search URLs, e.g. https://www.finn.no/job/search?q=utvikler&location=1.20001.20012. Leave empty to build a search from Keyword/Location.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search text (used when no Start URLs are given).

location.title: Location
location.description: County or municipality name (e.g. Rogaland, Haugesund, Oslo) or a Finn location code like 1.20001.20012. Used only when no Start URLs are given.

maxPages.title: Maximum search pages per URL
maxPages.description: Stop after this many result pages per start URL (about 50 ads per page).

includeDetails.title: Fetch full ad details
includeDetails.description: Opens every ad for description, deadline and employment type. Slower, more requests.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Try without a proxy first; enable if Finn blocks requests.
